notes.title: Build 0.45!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I know there are people who don't follow the game on Patreon, but just want to buy it when it comes out. Sometimes I see questions about whether the game has been abandoned... Of course not! Development is in full swing and recently we published build 0.45, where we added a new location for making money - Bikers Bar.

In the next update, we want to prepare events for the 3rd and 4th levels of fame, up to the fight against the second boss :)

notes.title: Page update :)
notes.notes:
Hello!

I know that not everyone follows the development on our patreon. In this case, you may be surprised by the long development (considering the rest of our projects on Steam). This is our main project at the moment and it will be significantly larger than our other games, and, I hope, you will like it much more :)

Right now development is in full swing and today I have slightly updated the screenshots to a more recent state. I hope you will like it :)
